en-US.description:
🎤 [Reporter Kim Hyun-ji]
The government is supporting young farmers,

leading the future of rural areas!

The first round of applications for the '2026 Youth Farmer Settlement Support Project' has begun.

Young farmers or prospective farmers aged 18 to 40

with three years or less of independent farming experience

and who meet the income requirements are eligible to apply.

2,000 applicants will be selected in this round,

and a second round will be held in the second half of the year.

Selected young people will receive various support, including a monthly farming settlement subsidy of up to 1.1 million won for up to three years, a successor farmer fund, and preferential guarantees from the National Agricultural Cooperative Federation.

Applications are accepted through the Agricultural and Forestry Business Information System until the 11th of next month.

The final list of applicants will be announced in January of next year.
